requirements.title: Certificado Veterinário Internacional (CVI, APHIS-endorsed)
requirements.description: The Certificado Veterinário Internacional (CVI) is completed by a USDA-accredited veterinarian and endorsed by APHIS — not a generic Form 7001. It is valid for 60 days from the day the vet signs it, and must still be valid on arrival in Brazil.

manual_checklist.title: Internal + external parasite treatment within 15 days of CVI issue
manual_checklist.detail: A licensed vet administers internal + external antiparasitic treatment within 15 days before the CVI is issued and records it on the certificate.

manual_checklist.title: Verify all paperwork BEFORE boarding
manual_checklist.detail: Pets arriving in Brazil without the required documents can be re-exported, quarantined, or in rare cases euthanised.
